Research on Renewable Energy & Machine Learning

⟡ Analysis of Pressure-Based Energy Harvesting with Intelligent Systems for Crosswalks

In the summer of 2026, I attended UC Santa Cruz COSMOS, where I studied Smart and Sustainable Power. During the program, I worked on a team of four to create a research poster on pressure-based energy harvesting and intelligent systems for crosswalks.
